Subject: Thanks for signing up — next steps

Hi Ryan,

Thanks for signing up for Redwood Inference — welcome! We’ve reserved some optional demo formats depending on what you want to see: a short 25-minute product walkthrough (best for feature fit) or a 45-minute technical deep-dive (for infra/security questions).

Pick a slot here: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo?utm_source=signup

If you already have specific questions (SSO, retention, compliance), reply to this thread and we’ll make sure the right person is on the call.

Cheers,
The Redwood Team

Hey Ryan — Ben here (Account Executive). Saw you signed up — congrats and welcome. I’m happy to coordinate a quick call to walk through the product and get a sense of your priorities. Two ways to do this:

- Quick 25-min walkthrough (fast scope + next steps)
- 45-min tech session with an engineer on the call (SSO, data residency, latency expectations)

If you want a fast route, pick a time on my calendar: https://calendly.com/ben_carter/30min
If you’d prefer, reply with three windows that work for you and I’ll lock it in. Monica (cc’d) can also drop a calendar invite.

To surface a few things ahead of time: are you evaluating for internal tooling or customer-facing products? Any constraints around VPC/KMS or on-prem requirements?

Thanks — talk soon.

Ben Carter
